devsec_jamie: Heads up — since 03:12 UTC we started seeing snapshot-restore Decrypt failures: KMS::AccessDenied in prod-db backups. :lock: Anyone touching CMKs or grants?
sam_infra: I did a grant sweep last night to remove unused grants, but only on test keys. didn't touch prod keys. :thinking:
liz_ops: saw S3 PUTs of snapshots successful, but restore job fails with 403 Decrypt errors. logs: ``ERROR Decrypt failed: AccessDenied``. Rolling back any recent RBAC changes is high priority.
ariane_sre: quick check — can we confirm if the CMK had an explicit grant for the snapshot-service principal? run: ``aws kms list-grants --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-efgh``
priya_secrets: Also check CloudTrail for kms:Decrypt events around the restore time: Athena query suggestion: ``SELECT eventTime, userIdentity.principalId, eventName, requestParameters FROM cloudtrail_logs WHERE eventName='Decrypt' AND resources LIKE '%key/abcd-efgh%' ORDER BY eventTime DESC LIMIT 50;``
devsec_jamie: Verified — there is a 03:01 event where iam:DeleteGrant happened by principal `console-admin` — looks like an automated housekeeping script. Did that run? @sam_infra
sam_infra: ugh that's my cron job (grant-pruner). It erroneously matched prod CMK due to tag mismatch. I can re-create grants immediately.
liz_ops: For immediate mitigation, re-add grant and restart restore job. If grant recreation not possible, fallback is to use cross-account decrypt role with envelope keys — but long.
priya_secrets: Grant creation command (aws cli):
```
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/prod-snapshots --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/snapshot-service --operations Decrypt Encrypt GenerateDataKey --name restore-grant
```
Make sure to set retiringPrincipal if needed.
kms-bot: Alert: new grant created for key alias/prod-snapshots by sam_infra at 03:28 UTC
devsec_jamie: After grant re-create, restore succeeded at 03:35. Good. Next: root cause & postmortem action items:
1) Fix grant-pruner to exclude keys with tag `env=prod` or with tag `managed-by=snapshots`. Add dry-run.
2) Add automated CloudWatch alarm on kms:Decrypt AccessDenied spikes for snapshot-service principal.
3) Expand audit logs: add a daily Athena check for kms:CreateGrant/DeleteGrant unexpected principals.
4) RBAC: enforce that only `secops` group can delete grants on CMKs tagged prod.

sam_infra: I'll open a PR for the cron fix and config change. Estimated ETA for deployment 6 hours.
ariane_sre: Also adding runbook steps to incidents repo: include commands to re-create grant, sample policies, and to revert grant-pruner. Make sure to redact ARNs in public docs.
priya_secrets: Marking this as Sev2; will file vuln-triage ticket for the grant-pruner logic (possible insufficient scoping). Also propose rotating CMK if any evidence of compromise — none found.
devsec_jamie: +1. Will draft postmortem and include timeline, mitigation, code pointers. Thanks all :thumbsup:
sam_infra: FYI I'll add an audit webhook to Slack when DeleteGrant occurs for prod keys.
liz_ops: And add test harness so grant-pruner runs against a fake keyset before applying. :white_check_mark:
devsec_jamie: Closing thread when postmortem links are posted. Good catch everyone.
